# planar.types: Quad2D

This slice: Quad2D, Parallelogram2D.

```plato

// Four vertices in counter-clockwise order. Assumed simple (edges do not cross);
// not necessarily convex or a parallelogram.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadrilateral)
type Quad2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, IPointSet2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D, IDeformable2D
{
    A: Point2D;
    B: Point2D;
    C: Point2D;
    D: Point2D;
}

// The quadrilateral spanned from Origin by two side vectors: vertices at Origin,
// Origin + SideA, Origin + SideA + SideB, and Origin + SideB
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parallelogram). Degenerate when the sides are
// parallel.
type Parallelogram2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    SideA: Vector2D;
    SideB: Vector2D;
}
```
